---
title: "About Me"
---

I'm an urban planner, data researcher, and educator based in Columbus, Ohio. I like digging into technical problems and breaking down complex issues to support the understanding of decision-makers and the public.

I've worked at the Ohio Department of Transportation in the Division of Planning, where I authored the state's first comprehensive report on travel forecast accuracy in over a decade. Prior to planning, I worked as a high school English language instructor in Guebwiller, France. I've also served as a teaching assistant for a course on transportation and land use during grad school. Education is one of my great passions, and I enjoy all aspects of the teaching process. 

I attended the Ohio State University for my Master of City and Regional Planning and also for Bachelor of Arts in Arabic, French, and Political Science. I've also studied at Middlebury Language Schools' Arabic program, where I researched the relationship between the aesthetics and spiritual practices of Sufi *turuq* and traditions.

### Personal

I am originally from [Columbiana, Ohio](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hGa9aznDReuS1wzT8), where I grew up on a maple syrup and Christmas tree farm. As a fan of the outdoors, I enjoy birding, hiking, and bouldering. You can find me biking along one of Central Ohio's many trails in all seasons. 

Among my many pursuits, I love making great coffee, designing fun maps, and reading books in new languages (currently Portuguese). Floral button downs, German pop music, and paging through the latest edition of *The Economist* bring me joy.
